# ANYmal C

```{image} ../../imgs/anymal_c.jpg
:alt: The ANYmal C environment
:width: 60%
:align: center
```

ANYmal C is a quadruped robot by ANYbotics. The model comes from MuJoCo Menagerie and derives from the description published by ANYbotics.

## Quick start

The registered name of this environment is `AnymalC`. There is no motion capture data for it, so it is created with {class}`~loco_mujoco.task_factories.rl_factory.RLFactory`, whose default task is to track a commanded root velocity.

`````{tab-set}
````{tab-item} MuJoCo (CPU)
```python
from loco_mujoco.task_factories import RLFactory

env, _ = RLFactory.make("AnymalC")

import numpy as np

env.reset()
for _ in range(1000):
    action = np.random.uniform(-1.0, 1.0, env.info.action_space.shape)
    obs, reward, absorbing, done, info = env.step(action)
    env.render()
```
````
````{tab-item} MJX (GPU)
```python
import jax

from loco_mujoco.task_factories import RLFactory

env, _ = RLFactory.make("MjxAnymalC")

n_envs = 1024
reset = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_reset, in_axes=(0, None)))
step = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_step, in_axes=(0, 0, None)))

keys = jax.random.split(jax.random.key(0), n_envs)
state = reset(keys, None)
action = jax.vmap(env.sample_action_space)(keys)
state = step(state, action, None)
```
````
`````

## Constructor options

This embodiment has no arguments of its own.

All environments also accept `spec`, `observation_spec` and `actuation_spec` to replace the model, the observation space and the set of actuators, and the arguments of {class}`~loco_mujoco.environments.base.LocoEnv` and {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.mujoco_base.Mujoco`, such as `timestep`, `n_substeps`, `reward_type`, `control_type` or `terrain_type`. See the [modular architecture](../user_guide/modular_architecture.md).

## Observation space

The default observation has 35 dimensions: the pose of the floating base without its horizontal position, the joint positions, the velocity of the floating base and the joint velocities. A task factory may append further entries; {class}`~loco_mujoco.task_factories.rl_factory.RLFactory`, for example, adds the velocity goal. See [observations](../user_guide/observations.md) for how to change the observation space.

| Index | Name | Observation type | Dim | Model element |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0–4 | `q_root` | {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.observations.base.FreeJointPosNoXY` | 5 | `root` |

## Action space

The action has 12 dimensions, one per actuator, each in [-1, 1]. The default control type of this environment is {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.control_functions.pd.PDControl`: an action is a joint position target, given as an offset from the nominal joint positions. The action is scaled from [-1, 1] to the joint range first. The target is clipped to the joint range, and the torque of the PD controller is clipped to the control range of the actuator. Another [control function](../user_guide/control_functions.md) can be selected with `control_type`.

| Index | Actuator | Acts on | Type | Joint range | Control range |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `LF_HAA` | `LF_HAA` | torque | [-0.72, 0.49] | [-80, 80] |
| 1 | `LF_HFE` | `LF_HFE` | torque | [-9.425, 9.425] | [-80, 80] |
| 2 | `LF_KFE` | `LF_KFE` | torque | [-9.425, 9.425] | [-80, 80] |
| 3 | `RF_HAA` | `RF_HAA` | torque | [-0.49, 0.72] | [-80, 80] |
| 4 | `RF_HFE` | `RF_HFE` | torque | [-9.425, 9.425] | [-80, 80] |
| 5 | `RF_KFE` | `RF_KFE` | torque | [-9.425, 9.425] | [-80, 80] |
| 6 | `LH_HAA` | `LH_HAA` | torque | [-0.72, 0.49] | [-80, 80] |
| 7 | `LH_HFE` | `LH_HFE` | torque | [-9.425, 9.425] | [-80, 80] |
| 8 | `LH_KFE` | `LH_KFE` | torque | [-9.425, 9.425] | [-80, 80] |
| 9 | `RH_HAA` | `RH_HAA` | torque | [-0.49, 0.72] | [-80, 80] |
